svg.aria-label: A PR flows into two stages. First an agent pass, which checks that the code matches the description, obvious bugs and edge cases, missing tests, unhandled errors, banned patterns and leftover debug code, in minutes at any hour. Then a human stage for judgement: is the approach right, are the trade-offs acceptable, does this fit the system. Underneath: stop counting PRs opened, start counting time to first review and merge-to-deploy time, with a review SLA that is a tracked, visible number.
svg.text: LET THE AGENT TAKE THE FIRST PASS
humans review the judgement, not the typos
minutes, any hour of the day
time to first review, merge-to-deploy time
